note: SIDECAR. Derived from evidence/gates.ndjson and the runners it names; NOTHING HERE WRITES gates.ndjson (S4) and NOTHING HERE RUNS A GATE (S10). Regenerate with `node viewer/classify_gate_attempts.cjs`; the `gate-attempts` gate refuses any difference.
why: PENDING collapses 'nobody has written a runner' and 'the runner exists and refuses' into one word, so the ledger cannot say which gates wait on WORK and which wait on the WORLD.
two_numbers: pending_now is the BACKLOG: gates whose LAST row still says PENDING. ever_pending is the HISTORY of that backlog: every gate that has ever worn the word, most of which were decided afterwards. The first version of this sidecar reported the second under the name of the first, which made the queue look five times longer than it is. Corrected 2026-07-28, caught by the L4 gate. Nothing was removed: each entry now carries current_verdict, so what waited and what stopped waiting are both readable.
